statement_en: Let $z_1,\ldots,z_n\in \mathbb{C}$ be a sequence such that $z_1=1$. Suppose that the sequence of\[s_k=\sum_{1\leq i\leq n}z_i^k\]contains infinitely many $(n-1)$-tuples of consecutive values of $s_k$ which are all $0$. Then (essentially)\[z_j=e(j/n),\]where $e(x)=e^{2\pi ix}$.
